$comment: Oklahoma postgame web edition (built Nov. 10, 2026): Oklahoma 23, Florida 7, Sat. Nov. 7, Ben Hill Griffin Stadium (ESPN event 401856739). Every number is from the ESPN pull (ok-pack stats.json / part1.json); every quote is verbatim from the UF/ASAP postgame transcripts or the Monday, Nov. 9 press conference transcript. No Florida pregame ranking anywhere (poll unverified). The Jones drive that ended in the third-quarter interception was 9 plays, 52 yards (ESPN), not 10. Desk stories are bylined GatorBait Staff; Behind the Sticks is by Brenden Martin. Photos: Nov. 7 UAA game files only, credited as filed; no player named unless the file name names him. Never cite, link or credit Gator Country. No PDF exists yet, so there is no download block (the renderer needs a usrfiles.com PDF URL).

damage.title: 203 yards and a game that never turned
damage.dek: Florida finished with 203 total yards to Oklahoma's 351, converted 2 of 9 third downs and turned the ball over twice. Oklahoma held the ball for 37:50.

stats.label: Florida rushing yards
stats.detail: 25 carries at 2.8 yards each. Oklahoma ran for 144 on 40 carries.

stats.label: Florida third downs
stats.detail: Oklahoma converted 10 of 18 and held the ball 37:50 to Florida's 22:10.

stats.label: Florida turnovers
stats.detail: Both were interceptions by Tramell Jones Jr. Oklahoma had none.

stats.label: Plays on Oklahoma's clinching drive
stats.detail: 89 yards and 12:45 off the clock, ending in a touchdown with 4:56 left.

stats.label: Plays on Florida's longest second-half drive
stats.detail: 52 yards in 4:17. It ended with an interception.

damage.source: Source: ESPN box score (event 401856739). Attendance: ESPN.

scoring.title: How the points came
scoring.dek: Oklahoma led 13-7 at halftime. Neither team scored in the third quarter, and Oklahoma added a touchdown and a field goal in the fourth. Florida's only points came on Jadan Baugh's 15-yard run late in the second quarter.

flow.title: How the game got away
flow.dek: Florida's chance to win, play by play. The Gators started at 66%, never had the lead and were at 50% after Baugh's touchdown made it 10-7 late in the second quarter. Oklahoma scored the next 13 points.

marks.note: Tate Sandell's 41-yard field goal with 7:36 left in the first quarter; Florida is at 57%
John Mateer finds Hayden Hansen from 3 yards with 9:42 left in the half; Florida is at 35%
Jadan Baugh's 15-yard run with 3:00 left in the half is Florida's only touchdown; Florida is at 50%
Sandell kicks a 48-yard field goal with 36 seconds left in the half; Florida is at 41%
Mateer to Isaiah Sategna III from 6 yards with 4:56 left in the game; Florida is at 2%
Sandell's 31-yard field goal with 1:56 left; Florida is at 0.1%

flow.summary: Line chart of Florida's win probability against Oklahoma. It starts near 66%, falls to 35% when Oklahoma goes up 10-0 in the second quarter, rises to 50% when Baugh's touchdown makes it 10-7, drops to 41% after Oklahoma's field goal before halftime, slides through the third quarter, falls below 2% when Oklahoma goes up 20-7 in the fourth and ends at 0%.
flow.source: Win probability: ESPN. GatorBait Media graphic.
